bit_identity.basis: every case is run once on the block and then LANES times on the single qualified lane, once per block lane on that lane's own column-major weight image and lane-local scale image built from the same weight elements; both checkers compare, element by element, the output word and the binary32 accumulator of each block lane against its reference run directly, both against the exact expectation, counters, error classes and details per lane, the unwritten sentinel on every element no lane was to write, and require the top's lockstep monitor to read zero; one differing bit fails the marker

does_not_establish.exhaustive_arithmetic: the sweep is seeded and directed, not exhaustive over the operand space
does_not_establish.integration: the block is driven directly by the checkers with ideal one-cycle memories; no staging SRAM, ROM bank or H-tree is modelled
does_not_establish.k_block_tree: K_BLOCK = K here; the pairwise tree over K-blocks and the tile sequencer are outside the block
does_not_establish.physical_realisability: simulation says nothing about area, timing or power; gates D3 and D4 need the physical flow
does_not_establish.scale_interleave: section 4.4 interleaves E8M0 scale bytes into the weight stream under a ROM-plan rule it marks as not yet written; the block keeps the scales on a separate table port

establishes: 8 lanes under one 16-byte weight stream port and shared activation ports produce, on both simulators, exactly the bits that independent runs of the single qualified lane produce on the same weight elements, over BF16 g = 1 and the FP8 g = 2 and MXFP4 g = 4 group modes, scaled and unscaled
the block retires 8 lane-ops per cycle in steady state (measured)
every lane-level failure mode traps distinctly at block level, on the shared side and on one lane's column, and the block's own refusals are distinct from them
the lanes stayed in lockstep on every cycle of every case (the top's monitor read zero)

vectors.column_assignment: lane i owns block columns c * LANES + i; lane-local column c

reference.rtl_reference: rtl/abi3/ot_a3_lane_pipelined.sv, run once per block lane on that lane's own images

vectors.scale_table_layout: one 8-byte word per lane-local E8M0 index c * (depth / block_b) + k / block_b; byte i holds lane i's code from the global A15 table for block column c * LANES + i
vectors.stream_layout: one 16-byte word per block lane-op in the lanes' issue order (row, pass of L interleaved local columns, k-group, column within the pass); lane i's g weight codes at bits [16 i +: 16], code j at [j * width +: width]

design.activation_ports: one 64-bit operand port and one 32-bit E8M0 port, shared by every lane
design.column_assignment: lane i owns block columns c * LANES + i
design.fault_policy: a faulting lane stops itself and writes nothing after its faulting pass; the other lanes complete; the block reports the lowest-numbered faulting lane's class and detail and every lane's beside them; cols not a multiple of LANES and a group whose weight codes exceed 2 B are refused before any lane starts
design.weight_scale_port: 8 B per read, indexed by the lane's own A15 index for its lane-local column
design.weight_stream_port: 16 B per cycle: 2 B per lane per lane-op in every format, sequential from cfg_w_base

failure_modes.policy: every fault case is run on both simulators; the block must report the expected class, detail and faulting lane, every lane its own class and detail, each lane must write exactly the elements of the passes it completed before its fault and nothing after, and the (class, detail) pairs of the preserved modes must be pairwise distinct

measured.definition: lane-ops retired by the block (the sum of the per-cycle retire count) divided by the clock cycles from the first to the last cycle with a retirement (inclusive) of the steady-state case, as counted by both checkers on the L = 3 build; the minimum over the suite's rate cases is reported, and the per-lane figure is that divided by 8.  The same lane-ops divided by the whole run's cycles is beside it
